channel.title: Tool Site HOT
channel.description: Tool Site HOT lists only tool websites you can use right away — converters, formatters, image tools, code tools and more. It discovers the newest tool sites every day from Product Hunt, Hacker News and other tool sources, scores them by rules, and shows only the title, a one-line summary and a link to the original — no articles, no news, no full text republished.

item.title: MyToolster
item.description: A free collection of online developer tools — Unicode converter, URL tools, QR codes, and audio and video utilities, all usable right in the browser.

item.title: Greatai Review: Free AI Code Review for Open Source
item.description: Paste a public repo link for a one-minute AI scan, then watch an AI review team work through the code on a live board, with an optional human expert review for maintainers.

item.title: FreeLLM
item.description: A directory of 500+ free LLM APIs from 31 providers including Google, Groq and OpenRouter, browsable by use case and model family — no more digging through docs to find a free API.

item.title: MyTypeFYI
item.description: Pick the fictional portraits that catch your eye across 20 rounds to find your visual preference type — no photo upload, free result.

item.title: ARC Chain Analyzer: Validate Email ARC Headers
item.description: Paste email headers to parse and visualize the ARC authentication chain, checking hop by hop whether forwarding broke SPF, DKIM, or DMARC validation.

item.title: Show HN: Name the World – An Atlas Quiz
item.description: Guess country names on a world map and learn where each one sits as you play.

item.title: Nova by Vybe
item.description: Paste a URL to analyze your website and find what could be better.

item.title: HelpCard
item.description: Make a free emergency card in a minute: blood group, allergies, medicines and who to call, all stored inside the QR code — nothing uploaded online.

item.title: DMARC Pulse
item.description: Turns daily DMARC reports into plain language: who is sending as your domain, what fails authentication, and how to fix it.

item.title: Conversaflex
item.description: AI speaking practice for corporate teams: rehearse real workplace conversations in French, English or Spanish, with progress tracking for HR.

item.title: MakeHit AI
item.description: Pick a trending meme video template, add your own photos, and get a shareable short video — no prompts to write, no timeline to edit.

item.title: Orelon: AI Cinematic Video Generator
item.description: Turn text or images into cinematic videos with director-style camera control and style presets, ready for social and marketing use.

item.title: Show HN: NetLoom, a live view into the Nano block lattice
item.description: A live visualisation of the Nano cryptocurrency's block lattice, showing transactions and account activity across the network as they happen.

item.title: Show HN: PlanCity – I find new housing developments across Europe every day
item.description: Finds new housing developments across Europe every day, handy for house-hunting or tracking the market.

item.title: ACR Packet: free red-flag checker for VPAT accessibility reports
item.description: Checks VPAT accessibility conformance reports for free and flags the problems, handy for writing or reviewing a report.

item.title: FreeAPI: test 1,047 public APIs in the browser without signing up
item.description: Try 1,047 public APIs right in the browser with no sign-up, handy for finding and testing an interface.

item.title: Curve: a free open-source SVG editor that works offline
item.description: A free open-source SVG editor that works offline, so you can draw vector graphics and edit icons right in the browser.

item.title: DailyTube Digest: a daily digest of your YouTube, X and Reddit feeds
item.description: Collects updates from the YouTube channels, X accounts and Reddit communities you follow into one daily digest, so you don't have to check every feed all day.

item.title: SynthCamp Mastering: Free Mastering in the Browser
item.description: Master your audio for free right in the browser — files never leave your machine, and you export the finished track when done.
